programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: Harvey Beaks
programme.desc: Harvey Beaks is a good kid on a mission to have fun, and nothing can stand in his way! Well, except for the fact that he irons his bed sheets and is always on time. Will his best friends, Fee and Foo, be able to help Harvey tap into his wild side? programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: When Gina's picnic is rained out, Wally decides to cheer her up by throwing a surprise picnic! He'll need his friends to keep her distracted and his magic stick to create H words that will help make the picnic happen!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father's from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father; in which Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down. His friendship is put to the test, as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath
programme.desc: This installment details the murders of James Barnes of Florida. In December 1997, he murdered his wife, Linda Barnes, in Melbourne, Florida. This confession is on audiotape. James Barnes only agreed to confess if Linda's ex-husband, Tony Verzi, was present. In January 1998, James Barnes was sentenced to life in prison for the murder of his wife. The murder of Linda Barnes was not his first murder. On November 1, 2005, at the Columbia Correctional Institution in Florida, James Barnes confessed to the 1988 murder of 41-year-old Patricia Miller. He had raped and killed her and then burned her body on a mattress. This murder had been unsolved for 17 years. In December 2007, Barnes was sentenced to death for the murder of Patricia Miller. The Miller confession is on videotape. As of January 2023, he is still awaiting execution while his case goes through the appeals process.

Her body, buried in a shallow grave, was found by police on October 31, 2019. She had noticed unusual labor law financial dealings by one of the co-owners of the deli, Greek immigrant Georgios Kakavelos, who feared she would report him to the authorities. In the end, both Georgios Kakavelos and Jimmy Duffy (a man Kakavelos hired for $1600 to murder and hide the body) were arrested and charged with her murder. Duffy was sentenced to "18 years to life" in prison. Kakavelos was sentenced to "life in prison without the possibility of parole."

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: On June 14, 2013, 19-year-old Adrienne Salinas and her two roommates are hosting a party at their apartment in Tempe, Arizona. The party is in full swing when Adrienne suddenly decides to leave. She gets in her car, drives away, and never returns home. In the days that follow, her family and friends work side by side with Tempe PD searching for Adrienne. When her body is discovered in a desert river basin, 35 miles awhile from her Tempe home, investigators suspect foul play. When all of their leads become dead ends, the case goes cold. But two years after Adrienne's body was discovered, a local man calls Tempe PD with a tip that his best friend, known around town as The Zombie Hunter, could be connected to Adrienne's disappearance and mysterious death.

programme.title: True Crime with Aphrodite Jones
programme.desc: Crime documentary series hosted by Aphrodite Jones who looks into real-life crimes including some of the most atrocious murders of recent times. Jones shares details of these gruesome crimes alongside authentic footage, evidence and interviews with people associated to the case – sometimes even the perpetrator themselves. Subjects featured in the series include such high-profile cases as O. J. Simpson, Michael Jackson, the notorious Zodiac serial killer and the music producer Phil Spector. Jones attempts to get inside the minds of her subjects to better understand their motives for committing such unspeakable crimes. Aphrodite Jones is a true-crime expert, a former crime reporter for FOX News and the author of eight books.

programme.desc: Documentary series that tells true and often tragic stories of the crimes perpetrated on the internet and of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions - from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to maniacs searching for their victims in chat rooms. Series includes re-enactments, comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts, psychologists and interviews from friends and families of the victims. Rare episodes feature victims who were extremely lucky to survive and are able to tell us what happened.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Dog Detectives
programme.desc: Not only are they friendly, cuddly, kind and loyal, but man's best friend can also use their canine instincts to help law enforcement officials catch criminals. Using their remarkable sense of smell, which is up to 100,000 times more effective than that of humans, these policing pooches unearth deadly narcotics, smuggled goods such as ivory and even illegal immigrants. In this reality series we celebrate these canine crime fighters and the unbreakable bonds they have with their human handlers, showcasing their incredible abilities when out on call with UK police officers.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here

programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: Gold Divers
programme.desc: Join the group of miners on their quest to find gold in the waters of Nome in Alaska. This reality show follows crews on boats equipped with different gadgets for gold mining- typically consisting of a sluicing apparatus, a means of paydirt collection (dredge) and a cold-water-diving life support system. With many aggravating circumstances such as rough seas, poor underwater visibility, personnel issues, ocean-damaging equipment failures and more, these tough and high tempered people risk their lives every day in hopes of finding gold and getting the big payout.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life!

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard and Paul Cowland travel across the United Kingdom to uncover classic cars to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. The pair scour garages, barns and facilities to discover collectible cars which include the likes of the Morris Minor Traveller, Jaguar XJS, Rover P6 and a BMW 635 CSI among many others. The combination of Drew's expertise of negotiation and deal-making and Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge makes them a formidable team ready to tackle anything challenging that comes their way.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

The team visit workshops all over the USA, using their knowledge and experience to rev up the old girls and get their engines purring once more. With a serious amount of elbow grease on top of the help from Richard's team, the owners have a shot once more at a successful business.

programme.title: Last Chance Garage
programme.desc: Specialty car restoration mistakes are much more common than you'd think, and each episode of LAST CHANCE GARAGE features a car with a horrifying backstory: multiple shops, years lost, and tens of thousands of dollars in sunk costs. On the flip side of that struggle, audiences will see the customer and learn about their unique - and often deeply personal - connection to their car.

programme.title: Finding Escobar's Millions
programme.desc: At one time Pablo Escobar — the most wanted man on the planet — buried masses of his estimated multi-billion-dollar fortune all over Colombia. Legends say the vast majority of it has never been found. With never-before-granted access and permission in Colombia, two former intelligence officers armed with the skills and training from 10 years of work in the CIA go on the hunt for the alleged hidden treasure in Finding Escobar's Millions.

programme.title: The Face Doctors
programme.desc: From devastating genetic conditions to trauma and illness, the series follows patients undergoing life-changing surgery and cutting-edge treatment to rebuild their faces. A team of surgeons and prosthetists work together to change lives.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Sweet Home Sextuplets
programme.desc: Courtney and Eric Waldrop, their three older boys and sextuplet babies are a tight-knit family living on a sheep farm in small town Alabama. Their strong desire for one more baby resulted in the biggest possible surprise- sextuplets. Have a close look at this adorable family and all of its members starting from the days when there were "just" five of them. Risky pregnancy, premature birth, arriving home, taking care of six babies, managing the whole family and adjusting to the new pace of life- all of this and much more are there for the viewers.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress America
programme.desc: Looking for your perfect dress? Kleinfeld Bridal is the place for you. Follow brides as they head off on their search for the perfect wedding dress, no matter how big or small in the city of New York. Bringing their friends and family along to help them decide, will they girls trip to the store be an easy one? The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Sweet Home Sextuplets

Have a close look at this adorable family and all of its members starting from the days when there were "just" five of them. Risky pregnancy, premature birth, arriving home, taking care of six babies, managing the whole family and adjusting to the new pace of life- all of this and much more are there for the viewers.

programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Making a routine journey from Berlin, Crossair Flight #3597 is on its final approach to Zurich. It is one of the last planes scheduled to land. But just minutes before landing the pilots cannot find the runway. They decide to abort the maneuver and apply full power to all four engines in order to get their jet to climb. But they are too late. The aircraft clips the treetops below and crashes into a hillside. Investigators comb through the wreckage, and the data from the plane's black boxes. But they would only solve the riddle of Crossair Flight 3597 by digging into the past.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Radio silence between pilots and air traffic controllers can mean many different things, but only the physical evidence can reveal the true story. Three shocking cases send investigators hunting for answers. A Greek airliner goes rogue and crashes outside Athens. A China Airlines 747 disappears from radar and the culprit is discovered on the ocean floor. And, when controllers lose contact with a private jet, fighter planes scramble to intervene.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. In this episode we learn just how many ways there are to embarrass, injure and humiliate yourself when BASE jumping, pulling a BMX nose wheelie and showing off your sword skills.

programme.title: Engineering Europe: Compilations
programme.desc: Underground, over mountains and across water, Europe's landscapes demand all forms of transportation to connect its citizens. The iconic 139-year-old Tower Bridge in London, which sees thousands of commuters every day, must be ready at a given moment to stop traffic and let boats through. The lesser-known Galecopperbrug in Utrecht, Netherlands, needs to undergo a major renovation to support its steel cables. Meanwhile, extensive and innovative renovations in the middle of Amsterdam will revolutionize rail and bike traffic, while a high-speed railway in the mountainous Basque Country of Spain will create a network that connects commuters to major cities. Engineers need to be cunning, innovative and flexible to keep up with the modern-day demands of European transportation.

programme.title: Building Impossible with Daniel Ashville
programme.desc: Daniel joins teams in both Austria and Italy to help shore, bore, and blast to help build one of the longest underground rail connections in the world. In Austria he blasts through the bedrock with dynamite and in Italy he controls a massive tunnel boring machine as the two countries get close to meeting in the middle.

programme.title: Building Impossible with Daniel Ashville
programme.desc: Daniel travels to Las Vegas, where Madison Square Garden's building a massive sphere. It's a game-changing venue, where audiences will experience amazing shows both inside - and outside the screen-covered sphere. Daniel joins the crew as they lift and bolt LED mega-panels to sphere's exterior. But inside, Daniel must scale horrifying heights to get the job done.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Plane Crash Recreated Plane Crash Recreated 10 x 60' As passengers, every time we board an aeroplane, we place our trust in the pilot, airline and the aircraft manufacturer and while flying remains the safest form of travel, accidents still happen. 'Plane Crash Recreated' will explain and investigate the world's most infamous plane crashes. Using survivor stories, expert interviews and black-box data, we will experience the final harrowing moments on board these notorious flights. But could the outcome have been different? Using a team of highly skilled test pilots and our own cutting edge flight simulator, we show you the extreme pressure inside the cockpit. When faced with failure, our military, commercial, aerobatic and test-pilots will need to make split-second life-or-death decisions. How will their vastly different training affect their outcome? And with the benefit of hindsight, what would they do differently?

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Lion Air Flight 610 was just 13 minutes into flight from Jakarta, Indonesia, when it plunged into the sea on 29 October 2018. This was the first fatal aviation accident for the 737 MAX, killing all 189 people on board. Just five months later, tragedy struck again on 10 March 2019, when the 737 Max serving Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302, crashed approximately six minutes after takeoff from Ethiopia, again killing all passengers and crew. What followed was an intense investigation into what caused these two devastating crashes. In this episode former NTSB investigators talk us through how these tragedies could have been avoided..

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: 12 August, 1985 saw the deadliest single-aircraft accident in aviation history. Japan Airlines Flight 123 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight carrying 524 people from Tokyo to Osaka. Just 12 minutes into the flight, the Boeing 747 jumbo-jet suffered a fatal decompression that ripped off most of the tail. With a total loss of hydraulics, the crew were unable to control the aircraft which tragically crashed into a mountainside. This episode features the account of a widowed partner of one passenger who perished in the crash, on why the grief from the tragedy still lives on..

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: On the west coast of Puerto Rico, Air and Marine Operations chase down and arrest smugglers caught tossing bales of cocaine overboard. At the Fort Lauderdale Airport, U.S. Customs and Border Protection seizes over a thousand hydrocodone pills from an airline pilot returning from Colombia. At Atlanta International Airport, CBP consults with archaeologists to verify the authenticity of several artifacts they suspect were looted.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.desc: Follow the dedicated teams working tirelessly 24/7 at Amsterdam Central Station, where managing over 1,500 trains and 180,000 passengers daily is no easy feat—especially during Pride Day. When a train loses power, it's a race against time for traffic control and emergency responders. Adding to the challenge, the station is undergoing the largest renovation in its history, all while keeping to a full schedule.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The station is undergoing an impressive transformation, with the old railway bridge being replaced by a gigantic steel structure. Superintendent Leon faces a huge challenge in this complex operation. Security & Services staff accompany two undocumented migrants to the Asylum Seekers Application Centre, while Gusta helps travelers recover lost property in the Lost & Found department.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: January 15th, 2009 - Less than two minutes after taking off from New York's LaGuardia Airport, US Airways Flight #1549 collides with a flock of birds. Both engines suddenly lose all thrust, and the Airbus A-320 begins falling from the sky. The crew desperately tries to restart their engines, but can't. With New York on one side and New Jersey on the other, Captain Chesley Sullenberger is running out of options. Searching desperately for a place to land, Sullenberger warns passengers and crew to brace for impact and tells the control tower that he will be ditching the plane in the icy waters of the Hudson River. Amazingly, all 155 people on board survive, and investigators try to determine how birds could have crippled two of the world's most advanced jet engines. Can they prevent it from happening again?

programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: When cases run cold, police in 1970s U.S. call upon the services of Dorothy Allison — the most celebrated "psychic detective" of her time. From the kidnapping of Patty Hearst to the crimes of Son of Sam, Allison sometimes provides incredible insights. In the 2010s, John of God is a leading light of the New Age movement with celebrity followers. He calls himself a psychic healer, but those closest to the man know that the truth is darker than anyone can imagine. In the first century C.E., Jewish commander Josephus is captured by the Romans. Apparently using ancient prophecy for political ends, he tells his captor, Roman General Vespasian, that he is prophesied to rule the world. The consequences have far-reaching effects on human history.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: A construction crane in the heart of New York City, Italy's iconic Morandi Bridge, and a multistory department store in Korea — three major disasters linked to engineering errors. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design flaws that spiraled into structural collapse. How does a series of oversights, design flaws, and negligent decisions lead to deadly catastrophes?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Space shuttle Columbia, the Deepwater Horizon oil rig, and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant are three major disasters linked to engineering and design flaws. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design choices that turned failures into catastrophes. What turned Columbia's return into a disaster? Why didn't the oil rig's final defenses hold? And how did a massive wave defeat emergency backups?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

Conservators in Poland scale the continent's tallest wooden tower to preserve a piece of history, while teams in the Nordics and Germany break ground with architectural firsts. Interviews with experts and site leads offer a close look at how vision and expertise intersect to redefine what's possible in vertical construction across Europe.

programme.title: Engineering Europe: Compilations

From eco-friendly megaprojects to centuries-old ingenuity, European engineers blend tradition and technology to restore, protect and transform the continent for generations to come.

Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G3. Hapoel TA - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Piire ületades
programme.desc: USA 2014 ulmepõnevik Lavastaja: Wally Pfister Osades: Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall, Paul Bettany Dr Will Caster (Johnny Depp) on juhtiv teadlane tehisintellekti valdkonnas, kelle eesmärgiks on luua teadvust omav masin, kes kannaks endas nii kogu inimkonna poolt läbi aegade ammutatud infot kui ka kõiki inimemotsioone. Ta ülimalt vastuolulised katsed on talle kuulsust toonud, ent samas teinud tast ka tehnoloogiavastaste äärmuslaste peamise sihtmärgi. Nood teevad kõik, et teda peatada. Ent püüdes Willi hävitada, sunnivad äärmuslased tahtmatult teda hoopis edu nimel suuremat ohvrit tooma - ta otsustab end katsejänesena üleloomulikuks moondada. Ta naise Evelyni (Rebecca Hall) ja parima sõbra Max Watersi (Paul Bettany) jaoks, kes töötavad mõlemad sama projekti kallal, pole küsimus selles, kas nad suudavad seda teha, vaid selles, kas nad peaksid seda tegema. Nende suurimad kartused saavad tõeks, kui Willi teadmisjanu muutub näiliselt kõikehaaravaks võimuihaks, mille tagajärgi on võimatu ette aimata. Hirmutava tõsiasjana ilmneb vaid see, et teda võib olla võimatu peatada.

programme.title: Punane sekund
programme.desc: Ilusa ilmaga toimub meie kergliiklusteedel tihe liikumine - tasakaaluliikurite, elektrirulade ja -tõukerataste kasutajad segamini jalutajate, jalgratturite ja rulluisutajatega. Arusaamatused erinevate teekasutajate vahel ei ole harvad ja juba on juhtunud ka kokkupõrkeid. Kes, kuidas ja millisel teeosal peaks liikuma? Aga kui meie sekka tulevad vurama veel ka robotid?

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G3. AS Monaco - Olympiacos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.desc: Rein on sügavale spiooniskandaali mässitud ja endiselt vahistatud ning ilma juhatajata jaoksonnas valitseb tõeline kaos. Hans-Kristjan peab jaoskonnas juhtimise üle võtma ja see muudab segase päeva lauasa pööraseks. Nii sõbrad jaoskonnas kui ka Reinu naine üritavad olukorda lahendada ja Reinu vabaks saada. Siim-Sanderi skeemidel ei näi aga lõppu tulevat ja Reinu olukord näib tund-tunnilt lootusetum. Kas Rein saabki enam tagasi vabadusse või mässitakse lõplikult Siim-Sanderi lõksu?

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Ameerika paps

programme.title: Doktor Silva
programme.desc: Väikese maakoha perearstikeskusse tuleb tööle uus ja peen perearst Tallinnast - doktor Silva, kes on harjunud ooperis käima, kalamarja sööma ja kübaraid kandma. Nüüd peab pealinna daam kohanema aga hoopis uue ja otsekohesema elustiiliga. Lisaks punuvad tema vastu intriige perearstikeskusest vallandatud endine perearst Heimar ja pereõde Ester. Kange iseloomuga Doktor Silva ei kohku aga tagasi ja hakkab tegelema kohaliku rahva eriskummaliste haigusjuhtumitega, üritab külarahva umbusuga võidelda ja kõigele lisaks varjab ta oma hingesopis hämarat saladust, mis oli tema pealinnast pagemise põhjuseks.

programme.desc: USA 2017 märulikomöödia Lavastaja:Mark Cullen Osades:Bruce Willis, John Goodman, Jason Momoa Steve Ford (Bruce Willis "Visa hing" filmisari) on löödud, aga mitte veel nokaudis LA eradetektiiv, kelle era- ja tööelu põimuvad, kui kurikuulus jõuk mehe truu koera Buddy röövib. Öeldakse, et koer on inimese parim sõber. Steve näitab, mida on üks mees valmis oma sõbra nimel tegema.

Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Püramiidi tipus
programme.desc: Läänemaailm peab Ameerika avastajaks Christoph Kolumbust. Kuid Uus-Meremaal töötav Eesti soost bioantropoloog Elisabeth Matisoo-Smith väidab, et see pole tõsi - vähemasti 100 aastat enne kuulsat eurooplasest meresõitjat jõudsid Lõuna-Ameerika randa Polüneesia saarestikust pärit inimesed. Sellele järeldusele tuli eesti juurtega teadlane Vaikse ookeani väikesaartel elavate põliselanike ja nende koduloomade DNAd uurides. Just siinsed uurimistulemused lubavad Lisal väita, et üle ookeanide liiguti tunduvalt varem ja vastupidises suunas, kui seni arvatud. Kusjuures selle rahvusvahelist ažiotaaži tekitanud avastuse tegi Matisoo kanaluude põhjal! Saate autor on Mihkel Kärmas. Režissöör Tarvo Mölder, operaator Tauno Sirel, produtsent Ene-Maris Tali.

Sarja juhivad kaksikud dr Chris ja dr Xand van Tulleken, kes teevad teaduslikke katseid ja uurivad meditsiini ning bioloogia huvitavat maailma. Saa üle hirmust haigla ees ja vaata oma silmaga, mida põnevat seal tegelikult tehakse ning millised uskumatud protsessid meie kehas toimuvad. Suurbritannia linnades filmitud sarjas näeme päris patsiente kriisiolukorras ja meie arstid Chris ning Xand näitavad, kui põnevalt toimib kiirabi ja milleks on meie keha suuteline äärmuslikes olukordades.

programme.title: Aja peatajad
programme.desc: Teismeline aktiveerib kogemata käekella, mis võimaldab tal aega peatada.

programme.title: Ellujääja
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2015 märul Lavastaja:James McTeigue Osades:Milla Jovovich, Pierce Brosnan, Dylan McDermott Äsja Londonis asuvasse Ameerika Ühendriikide saatkonda lähetatud välisagendi (Milla Jovovich) ülesandeks on takistada terroristidel siseneda USA-ss. See viib naise otse tulejoonele, temast saab sihtmärk ja ta lavastatakse süüdi. Üritades oma nime puhtaks pesta, peab põgenev agent ära hoidma ka vana-aastaõhtuks Times Square'ile kavandatud laiaulatusliku terrorirünnaku.

programme.title: Vaikiv kurjus
programme.desc: Füüsikaprofessor kogub kokku rühma tudengeid, et ajada riituse käigus tüdrukust välja kuri energia, mille põhjustaks on tüdruku arvates üks nukk.

programme.title: Palaviku tippkohtumine
programme.desc: Sõpruskonna unistus vallutada maailma kõige keerukam kolmikmäetipp muutub õudusunenäoks, kui surmavalt ohtlik torm jätab sõbrad lõksu mäe jalami lähedal ja lõikab ära vähimagi lootuse päästetud saada.

programme.title: Patu linn 2
programme.desc: USA 2014 põnevusmärul Lavastaja:Frank Miller, Robert Rodriguez Osades:Mickey Rourke, Jessica Alba, Josh Brolin Marv (Mickey Rourke) lebab meelemärkuseta maanteel, ümberringi laibad. Teadvusele tulles üritab mälu kaotanud mees meenutada oma viimaseid samme pärast laupäeva öösel kõrtsist lahkumist. Talle meenub, et neli rikkurist elumeest üritas kodutut meest põlema panna, kuid Marv sekkus ja tegi noormehed vagaseks. Ülbe mängur Johhny (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) võidab kõrtsi mänguautomaadis jackpoti ja kutsub endaga kaasa ettekandja Marcie, et minna pokkerit mängima mõjuvõimsa Senator Roarki (Powers Boothe) vastu. Johnny võidab ja teeb mehe rahast lagedaks, kuid saab peagi tunda häbisse jäetud Roarki julma kättemaksu. Eradetektiivi Dwightiga (Josh Brolin) võtab ühendust endine armastus Ava Lord, kes palub mehelt andestust rikka Damian Lordiga abiellumise pärast. Kohtumise järel läheb Dwight naise maja juurde luurama, kuid Ava autojuht Manute tabab mehe ja koos ihukaitsjatega antakse Dwightile kere peale. Koju jõudes ootab Dwighti voodis alasti Ava, kes mehe taas võrgutab. Naine tunnistab, et Damian ja Manute piinavad teda ja tahavad teda tappa. Kui Manute naise taas ära viib, läheb Dwight koos Marviga Avat päästma. Kuigi Damian eitab süüdistusi, peksab Dwight mehe surnuks ning Marv rebib Manutel silma peast. Peagi aga selgub, et see kõik oli Ava punutud lõks ja naine tulistab Dwighti näkku. Marv päästab Dwighti ja viib mehe vanalinna endise armsama Gaili juurde taastuma, kus mees hakkab Ava vastu kättemaksu hauduma.

programme.title: Võõrkeha
programme.desc: Antarktika uurimisjaamas töötavad teadlased astuvad võtlusse tulnukaga, kes suudab oma ohvrite kuju võtta.

programme.title: Grindhouse: Õuduste planeet
programme.desc: Pärast testjärgus biorelva vabastamist muutuvad tuhanded zombilaadseteks olevusteks ning ellujäänute ülesandeks on peatada nakatunud ja biorelva vabastamise taga olevad inimesed.

programme.title: Hollywoodland
programme.desc: "Hollywoodland" põhineb tõestisündinud lool, käsitledes Hollywoodi kurikuulsaimat lahendamata mõistatust ja viib vaataja keset 1950ndate aastate Los Angelese glamuuri, skandaale ja korruptsiooni. Kui telesaate "Supermani seiklused" staar George Reeves (Ben Affleck) leitakse oma kodust surnuna, on miljonid fännid ta surma asjaoludest šokeeritud. Politsei ja stuudiobossid soovivad, et juhtum lõpetaks enesetapuna, kuid kuulujutud ei kao. Eradetektiiv Louis Simo (Adrien Brody) võtab jälje üles ja hakkab kildudest kokku panema näitleja viimaseid, pingetest tulvil päevi. Kes vajutas päästikule? Kas see oli võrgutav, ent intriige punuv kihlatu, mahajäetud armuke (Diane Lane), raevunud abikaasa (Bob Hoskins) või hoopis Reeves ise?

programme.title: Vabaliikumises
programme.desc: Suurlinnas elav teismeline Ren MacCormac kolib väikelinna, kus on keelustatud rockmuusika ja tantsimine. Nooruki mässumeelne vastuhakk raputab kohalikke.

programme.title: Sügis New Yorgis
programme.desc: Romantiline draama jõukast naistekütist (Richard Gere), kel tekib suhe endast poole noorema kaunitariga (Winona Ryder). Will plaanib Charlotte pärast esimest ühist ööd hüljata, kuid siis avaldab naine talle ehmatava saladuse - ta põeb eluohtlikku vähki. See valus pihtimus annab nende suhtele täiesti ootamatu pöörde.

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Ära iial ütle iial
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm jälgib Justin Bieberit ja näitab kaadreid tema esinemistelt 2010. aasta turneel.

programme.title: Näljamängud: Pilapasknäär - Osa 2
programme.desc: Ulmesaaga Katniss Everdeeni võitlusest Kapitooliumi diktatuuri ja president Snow vastu jõuab dünaamilisse ja pingelisse finaali.

programme.title: Liblikmehe ettekuulutus
programme.desc: Kaks aastat pärast oma naise traagilist surma satub ajakirjanik ameerika väikelinna, kus toimuvad seletamatud sündmused.

programme.title: A.I. - tehisintellekt
programme.desc: Inimkond on loonud robotid, kes suudavad tunda tundeid, kuid ei ole võtnud vaevaks õpetada neid oma emotsioonidega toime tulema. Laps-robot püüab oma niinimetatud ema armastust tagasi võita.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Noor aristokraadineiu arvab, et rikas naine võib olla ühiskonnas lugupeetud ka vallalisena. Nii aitab ta teisi naisi, kel pole elus sama hästi läinud, unustades seejuures sageli iseenda tunded.

programme.title: Õnne otsinguil
programme.desc: Chris Gardner on taibukas, kuid edutu müügimees, kes üritab kõigest väest toita oma peret, abikaasat ja 5-aastast poega Christopheri. Kuna see näib olevat võimatu, läheb naine nende juurest ära. Veidi hiljem tõstetakse mees koos pojaga korterist välja. Püüdes ots otsaga kokku tulla, trügib Chris praktikandiks mainekasse maaklerifirmasse, taludes samas mitmeid raskusi ja ööbides juhuslikes kohtades. Hoolimata vastukäimistest peab mees kinni oma lubadusest olla armastav ja hoolitsev isa, ammutades jõudu oma poja usaldusest. Režissöör Gabriele Muccino, osades Will Smith, Thandie Newton, Jaden Smith jt.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Lugu New Orleansi ringkonnaprokurör Jim Garrisonist, kes hakkab uurima John Kennedy mõrva 1963. aastal Texase osariigis Dallases.

programme.title: Kuritöö värv
programme.desc: Must politseidetektiiv peab lahendama kummalise kuritöö, mille keskmes on röövitud poiss, ning tegelema suure rassistliku protestiaktsiooniga.

programme.title: Minu nädal Marilyniga
programme.desc: Tõsielul põhinev armastuslugu. 1956. aasta suvel astus värskelt Oxfordi ülikooli lõpetanud 23-aastane Colin Clark esimesed sammud filmimaailmas ja tema esimeseks projektiks sai "The Prince and the Showgirl", mis viis kokku Briti superstaari sir Laurence Olivier ja maailma seksikaimaks naiseks peetud Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Grissom ja Sara jätkavad David Hodgesi vastu esitatud süüdistuste uurimist. Ülejäänud meeskond leiab purskkaevust videomängude arendaja laiba.

programme.title: Krimi
programme.desc: Eesti staažikaim politseisaade toob vaatajateni olulisemad krimiuudised. Uudiseid elu pahupoolelt vahendab saatejuht Taavi Otsus.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Ella kurvastab, et Georgi ja Isa suhted on endiselt sassis, kuigi Georg ei anna alla ja aina püüab ning püüab Isaga rääkida. Linda suudleb Chrisi ja meest valdab tunnetekaos. Proua Kleinil hakkab halvem ja Chris ning Ella jooksevad ajaga võidu, et naist päästa. Lukas kutsub Becky neile elama.

programme.title: Reporter
programme.desc: Uudistemagasinide lipulaev, mis toob olulisemad ja põnevamad uudised kodumaalt ja mujalt maailmast vaatajateni Reporterile omasel mahlakal moel. Saatejuhid on alati soliidsed Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap.

programme.title: Telehommik
programme.desc: "Tere hommikust, Telehommik alustab," tervitavad vaatajaid igal argipäeva hommikul saatejuhid Romi Hasa ja Kristjan Gold Kanal 2 otsestuudiost. "Telehommik" alustab päeva värskete uudiste, sisukate vestluste ja mõnusa meelelahutusega. Hommiku jooksul jõuavad ekraanile põnevad külalised ja lood Eestimaa eri paigust ning jagatakse praktilisi nõuandeid. See on hommik täis head tuju ja vajalikku infot, millega pikale päevale vastu minna.

programme.title: 15 küsimust
programme.desc: Kodumaine strateegiline mälumäng, mille muudab kaasahaaravaks põnev vihjete süsteem ja strateegia element. Saates on vastamisi kaks mängijat, kel on võimalus hakata panustama enda tugevustele ning samal ajal vastase nõrkusele. Mõnikord võib selline tegutsemine edu tuua, aga teinekord hoopis kätte maksta ning vajalikest punktidest ilma jätta. Saadet juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Telehommik
programme.desc: "Tere hommikust, Telehommik alustab," tervitavad vaatajaid igal argipäeva hommikul saatejuhid Romi Hasa ja Kristjan Gold Kanal 2 otsestuudiost. programme.title: Täistund
programme.desc: Ajakirjanduslik telemagasin, mis süveneb nii Eesti kui ka maailma päevakajalistesse sündmustesse, tuues vaatajateni sisukad arutelud ja põhjalikud intervjuud. Saates käsitletavad teemad ulatuvad kodustest probleemidest kuni rahvusvaheliste kriisideni, tasakaalustades tõsiseid teemasid kergemate ja meelelahutuslike lugudega. "Täistunni" meeskonda kuuluvad kogenud ajakirjanikud Elo Mõttus-Leppik, Neeme Raud, Madis Kimmel, Brita-Maria Alas, Sander Punamäe, Mart Mardisalu ja Raul Ranne.

programme.title: Meie aasta Austraalias
programme.desc: Pakime toidu- ja veevarud nädalaks ning suundume oma salajasse paika, kus meie kaaslasteks on vaid kookaburrad ja hiigelvaraanid. Leiame aborigeenide kaljujoonised ja kaome veeauku.

programme.title: Küladetektiivid
programme.desc: Ettevõtja Oliver Naumann lastakse koduuksel maha. Õnneks leidub juhuslik pealtnägija, kes suudab meelde jätta mootorratta numbri, millega kurjategija põgenes. Hofer ja Hansen leiavad kiiresti ratta, kuid edasi läheb asi keeruliseks, sest ratta omanik pole väidetavalt enam ammu rattaga sõitnud… Keerulise sasipuntra lahendamisel on abiks liiklusõnnetus, mida esimesel hetkel ei osata mõrvajuhtumiga seostada.

programme.title: Mägipäästjad
programme.desc: Markuse lapsepõlvesõber Stefan hakkab Sofiaga abielluma. Sofia näeb õudusunenägudes võõrast maja ning ehmub, kui avastab Ramsaus just sellise maja. Nina üritab Miaga jutule saada, tüdruk ei taha teda aga kuulda võtta. Katharinal ja Lukasel on tõsine jutuajamine.

programme.title: Proua Fazilet ja tema tütred
programme.desc: Häärberi uus perenaine nõuab austust, mida ta enda arvates väärib. Fazilet ei tunnista sel teel ühtegi takistust. Tema survel hävitab Hazim Ece allkirjastatud abieluvaralepingu ja täidab ta tingimusi. Yasemin asub oma plaani ellu viima. Sinanis tärkavad kahtlused, kui ta näeb Yagizi ja Hazanit koos aega veetmas.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Chris räägib Ellale suudlemisest Lindaga, tehes talle sellega väga haiget. Kuigi Ella püüab sellest täiskasvanu kombel üle olla, leiab Linda võimaluse haavale soola raputada. Ka Chris tunneb, kui lähedased nad Lindaga siiski on. Beckyle tuleb isa külla.

programme.title: Naabriplika
programme.desc: Vallavanema ämm on noorte juurde kolinud ja norskab öösiti. Vallavanem ei saa magada, aga tulevane Eesti president peab magada saama. Kui president ei maga, siis on kogu rahvas magamata. Vallavanema peas küpseb kurikaval plaan saata ämm presidendilossi ja ise jätkata Esnas poole kohaga presidendikarjääri. Kröösmani naine jätab Kröösmani maha, aga see ei takista Kröösmanil alustada Rolexi-äriga. Varik jätkab Aliinale külgelöömist. Tola meelehärm kasvab, aga saades tööd Koosaare poes, pole tal aega seda märgata. Insener ja Sookrates asuvad aga leiutama nähtamatuks tegevat pulbrit. Kiriklasse rajatud ilusalongis haarab aga saatana pintsli enda kätte kirikõpetaja ise.

programme.title: Reporter
programme.desc: Uudistemagasinide lipulaev, mis toob olulisemad ja põnevamad uudised kodumaalt ja mujalt maailmast vaatajateni Reporterile omasel mahlakal moel. Saatejuhid on alati soliidsed Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap.

programme.title: Kodud rahaks
programme.desc: Keset talve kõige krõbedamat aega lähevad Keili ja Merlin külmapealinna Jõgevale, et aidata kodu rahaks teha Ukraina juurtega Miroslaval. Tal on korter, mille haldamise muresid ja rõõme tuleb pärast ema surma jagada kolme õe vahel. Remondi otsustab Mira ära teha aga üksi ning õdesid üllatada.

programme.title: Õhtu!
programme.desc: Armastatud saatejuhid Piret Laos, Robert Rool ja Jüri Butšakov saadavad vaatajaid argiõhtus rõõmsameelse ja positiivse vestlussaatega. Stuudios arutatakse kõikvõimalikel teemadel ning ka tõsisemad jutud saavad aetud heas ja toetavas õhkkonnas. "ÕHTU!" paneb tööpäevale mõnusa punkti ja loob hea tuju.

programme.title: Metsiku Roose jälgedes
programme.desc: Seekordses osas valmistuvad meie reisisellid suureks pidupäevaks. Kord aastas peetakse Mehhikos surnute päeva. Sander ja Jaan võtavad suuna melu keskmesse ja vahendavad toimuvat.

programme.title: Mulle Eestist ei piisa!
programme.desc: Erisaade Eesti tudengite elust Inglismaal. Saatejuht Marian Võsumets külastab eesti noori Londonis ja Inglismaa väikelinnades, kus praegused ja endised tudengid on omandanud kõrghariduse ja uurib, mis nad Eestist ära on viinud. Kas Inglismaal elamine on tõepoolest kulukas? Kas noored plaanivad Eestisse naasta või igaveseks välismaale jääda?

programme.title: Kuninglike paleede saladused
programme.desc: Praegu kasutusel olevatest kuninglikest residentsidest kõige väiksema, Gloucesteris asuv Highgrove'i maja renoveeris prints Charles. Selle juurde kuulub mitmest "ruumist" koosnev väliaed, mida on kirjeldatud kui orgaanilist oaasi.

programme.title: Võimalik vaid TikTokis
programme.desc: Lustliku saate kangelased on värvikad inimesed, kelle uskumatud teod ja pöörased sekeldused jõuavad TikToki vahendusel miljonite vaatajateni. Saadet juhib Erkki Sarapuu.

programme.title: Võimalik vaid TikTokis
programme.desc: Elades huvitaval ajastul, kus iga päev toob midagi uut ja põnevat. Suurimat avastamisrõõmu pakub pidev teadmine, et maailm on täis värvikaid inimesi, kes suudavad korda saata uskumatuid tegusid, mida tihtipeale niinimetatud kaine mõistus ei suuda alati seletada. Uue saatesarjaga "Võimalik Vaid TikTokis" võtab Erkki Sarapuu endale missiooniks tutvustada selliseid "talente" televaatajatele ja tuua publiku ette "tõelise elu" kogemused.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Kui sul pole raha, et naisele kasukat osta, võivad sellel olla traagilised tagajärjed. Eriti, kui sa oma naist jäägitult armastad. Markus Reier on naise õnne nimel suuri laene võtnud, kuid ühel päeval ähvardab mull lõhkeda ja nüüd ei jää muud üle kui vabasurma minna. Oli see enesetapp või osav manööver?

programme.title: Läbi suve Taaviga
programme.desc: TV3 läbi suve kestev meeleolukas rännak läbi Eesti, mida veab iga eestlasega muhedalt jutu peale saav Taavi Libe. Sel suvel ei jää Taavi eest varjatuks ükski kodumaa kant, kus on leida huvitavaid inimesi või erilisi sündmusi.

programme.title: Läbi metsiku Kanada
programme.desc: Rentida Kanadas autot inimeselt inimesele süsteemi kaudu on midagi enamat, kui lihtsalt üks Kolgata tee. Kui lõpuks suurlinna melu keskelt õige auto üles leitakse, siis selle tehniline seisukord võib sihtkoha asemel viia otsejoones kalmistule. Lõbus reisiseltskond jõuab õnneks Niagara joa juurde. Kanada ja USA piiril asuv maailma üks veerohkemaid ja tuntumaid jugasid kostitab lummavate vaadetega ning kallab sekundiga vannitäie vett krae vahele.

programme.title: Rooside sõda
programme.desc: Kõige heatujulisem telemäng nüüdsest igal argiõhtul! Pere- ja sõpruskonnad peavad ära arvama, mida sada eestlast on küsimuste vastusteks pakkunud. Lõbusat nuputamist juhib Kristjan Jõekalda.

programme.title: Märgatud Eestis
programme.desc: Kuidas aidata sõpra, kes on prügi alla mattunud ja oma koju elama ei mahu. Ometi pole ta millestki nõus loobuma. Vägisi kedagi aidata kedagi ei saa ja mis ühele prügi, see teisele kuld.

programme.title: Laser
programme.desc: Kohtla-Järve pärit 19-aastase Jevgeni huvideks olid lapsporno, imikute piinamine, suguakt surnute ja loomadega, natsism, kommunism ja islam. Poisil oli reaalne plaan liituda ISISega ja korraldada terrorismiakte. Laser uurib, miks Eesti poisid radikaliseeruvad. Teises loos näitame, kuidas netikasiinod ei müü lihtsalt meelelahutust, vaid kasutavad teadlikult võtteid, mis hoiavad inimesi mängimas ja raha kaotamas. Kui lihtne on lõksu langeda ja miks tundub, et reeglid ei kehti kõigile võrdselt?

programme.title: Läbi suve Taaviga
programme.desc: TV3 läbi suve kestev meeleolukas rännak läbi Eesti, mida veab iga eestlasega muhedalt jutu peale saav Taavi Libe. Sel suvel ei jää Taavi eest varjatuks ükski kodumaa kant, kus on leida huvitavaid inimesi või erilisi sündmusi.

programme.title: Üle ja ümber Balkani päikese
programme.desc: Balkani päikese all seiklemine on võtnud oma aja, ent paar riiki on veel nimekirjast läbimata. Bosnia ja Hertsegoviinas külastatakse mäe otsa ehitatud ning sõjas kannatada saanud hirmkalleid ehitisi ning Horvaatias ei julge vaprad seiklejad metsa ööbima jääda. Kõike seda korvab aga järgmisel päeval külastatava rahvuspargi naturaalne ilu.

programme.title: Üle ja ümber Balkani päikese
programme.desc: Seiklejad täidavad veel täitmata ülesandeid viimastes Balkani riikides ning seejärel asutakse koduteele, mis osutub sama põnevaks nagu kogu reis. Väikeste tõrgete saatel jõutakse Poola, kus meenutakse eredaid hetki suurejooneliselt Balkani reisilt.

programme.title: Suletud uste taga
programme.desc: Sotsiaalhooldusest ja naise väikesest palgast elav perekond on võlgade tõttu sunnitud elukohta vahetama. Uues kortermajas aga ei meeldi Harry ettevõtmised teistele majaelanikele. Kui Harry pidusi korraldab ning keldreid tühjendab, saab põlu alla kogu Küpperite pere. Ema Inna on murest murtud, ta püüab naabritega suhteid siluda ent Harryle vastu seista esialgu ei julge.

programme.title: Suletud uste taga
programme.desc: Kui 25-aastane Siim end Mallorca-reisil purupurjus olekus 39-aastase Olga voodist leiab, ei ole tal aimugi kuidas see üheöösuhe tema senist elu muudab. Tagasi Eestis ilmub Olga Siimu ukse taha ja teatab, et neil on nüüd suhe. Naine jälitab noormeest ning lööb sassi suhted senise tüdruksõbraga.

programme.title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Üks arst ja kolm naist
programme.desc: Väike St.Marki küla elab vahetult enne suuri pidustusi liigagi rahulikku elu. Paiga ainus arst suundub pensionile ja uusi kandidaate on vaid üks: doktor Nael Rayan. Paraku on Nael kohaliku linnapea Heleni suur armastus, ent Helen on abiellumas kohaliku pastoriga. Seega püüab naine kõigest väest ära hoida, et Nael sellesse ametisse astuks. Asjad kulgevad omasoodu ja viimaks peavad Nael ja Helen mängima ühises etenduses, kus neil tuleb suudelda.

programme.title: Kirgede torm
programme.desc: Larissa üritab Kiliani südant võita. Yvonne leiab Eriku päeviku. Sophia üritab enda ja Christophi suhte järgmisele tasemele viia.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Marion meelitab Frida Pärnusse meelt lahutama. Ehkki Frida ei taha uutest tutvustest kuuldagi, kohtab ta ometi õhtusöögil unistuste meest. Ent kaua ei saa naine idülli nautida, kuna samal ajal hakkavad hotellis toimuma mõrvad ja Kättemaksukontor peab täistuuridel tööd alustama.

programme.title: Võimalik vaid TikTokis
programme.desc: Lustliku saate kangelased on värvikad inimesed, kelle uskumatud teod ja pöörased sekeldused jõuavad TikToki vahendusel miljonite vaatajateni. Saadet juhib Erkki Sarapuu.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Rooside sõda
programme.desc: Kõige heatujulisem telemäng nüüdsest igal argiõhtul! Pere- ja sõpruskonnad peavad ära arvama, mida sada eestlast on küsimuste vastusteks pakkunud. Lõbusat nuputamist juhib Kristjan Jõekalda.

programme.title: Naabrist parem
programme.desc: Nii kuldseid võidu- kui punaseid kaotusrosette koguneb hooga ja naabrid hakkavad üha enam mõistma, et tegu on karmi võistlusega. Ükskõik kui suured on nädala jooksul tehtud pingutused, jääb ikka keegi viimaseks ja see on alati valus. Vannitubade valmimisega on ränka vaeva näinud kõik -- Kasekesed peavad pulmade pidamise kõrvalt oma plaane palju ümber tegema. Maakatele valmistab peavalu kalasaba. Itinaised on hädas oma eriti vingete plaatidega. Perekond Püsimatud loodavad meistrimeestele.

programme.title: Täiuslik sõbranna
programme.desc: Kodumaise põnevus-draamasarja teises osas üritavad kolm sõbrannat oma ohtlikku minevikusaladust lahendada. Selleks tuleb üles leida teadmata kadunuks jäänud neiu poissõber ja veel üks selle saatusliku peo osaleja. Agnes saab juba järgmise ähvarduskirja...

programme.title: Eesti krimilood
programme.desc: Pesuvahendite müügiga tegelev Kuuno on mees, kes on valmis kasvõi kurikaga abil oma õigust taga ajama. Keerulise loomu tõttu on aga Kuuno suhted seisus, kus kõik uksed sulguvad tema ees. Mees otsib peavarju üksiku raamatupidaja, lahke loomuga Mari-Liisi kodust. Armunud naine ei näe aga, millised tumedad tungid mehes väljapääsu otsivad ja kui võikaid vorme võib võtta armukadedus. Kurikuulsa "kurikamehe" juhtumil põhinevas tõsielulises krimiseerias mängivad Rasmus Kaljujärv ja Eva Koldits. Stsenaarium ja lavastus Andres Maimik

programme.title: Bellingshauseniga Arktikas: Loodeväil
programme.desc: Purjelaev Admiral Bellingshausen rühib mööda Gröönimaa kallast üha põhja poole. Maagiline polaarjoon ei ole enam kaugel. Ümberringi laiuvad hingematvad jäämäed ja liustikud, mille suurus ja ilu panevad vaid õhku ahmima! Maismaal satutakse seekord ootamatult muusikafestivalile, mekitakse vaala pekki, korraldatakse üks arktiline safari ja vaadatakse üle, milline näeb välja maailma kõige põhjapoolsem Michelini tunnustusega restoran.

programme.title: Mägimehed
programme.desc: Tom peab ohtlikud hundid oma kinnistult eemale tõrjuma. Eustace'il saab vesi otsa, mistõttu suletakse Kilpkonnasaar. Lihtne viga võib Martyle kõik maksta.

Lisaks teravatele uurimustele vahendab saade ka haaravaid persoone ja meeldejäävaid reportaaže sündmustest, mille pealtnägijaks tavaline inimene naljalt ei satu. Saatejuht Mihkel Kärmas, kaasautorid Kristjan Pihl, Merilin Pärli, Taavi Eilat, Margit Kilumets ja Uljana Kuzmina. Režissöörid Raivo Maripuu ja Vladlen Pobjaržin, produtsent Piret Priisaar.

programme.desc: Alo Põldmäe räägib oma heliteosest, mis sündis 1969. aastal suure kosmosevallutamise ajal ja oli pühendatud Apollo kosmoselaeva suundumisele Kuule. Väga ajakohane lugu. Režissöör ja produtsent Jaan Tootsen, tootja Aadam ja pojad.

Režissöör Maire Radsin, toimetaja Anne-Mari Müller, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

On ju teater kui väike ühiskonna mudel, milles peegelduvad kõik meie vaevad, nõrkused, rikkused, õnnestumised ja ebaõnnestumised. Teatritegelasedki armastavad, vihkavad, konkureerivad ja loobuvad, punuvad intriige ning langevad nende ohvriks, kaotavad elus ja võidavad laval ning vastupidi.
